About the Project

Edinburgh’s AI for Biomedical Innovation CDT connects artificial intelligence with biomedical and health research. Applicants use the CDT’s current 2027 recruitment form.

Research Areas

  • AI
  • biomedical science and health data

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
FundingHome/Overseas tuition plus research/travel support under the studentship terms.
MaintenanceLiving stipend; confirm current rate
Duration4 years; September 2027 start

Eligibility and Requirements

Relevant quantitative, computing, engineering or biomedical/health background; check programme academic and English requirements. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment2027 recruitment open
Deadline20 January 2027, 13:00 UK

How to Apply

Complete the CDT application form and its requested statements/documents. Successful funding candidates subsequently complete university admission.

The current CDT application page confirms 2027 recruitment; older 2026 course dates should not be reused.

About The University of Edinburgh

The University of Edinburgh offers doctoral research across science, engineering, humanities, social sciences and health. Its research schools host scholarship competitions and doctoral training programmes with different admission and funding routes.
